name: Blithe
source:
It will be a story about someone who is trying to have a fresh start in life. 

Going to a town where his best friend is currently living, will he be able to redeem himself from his past?

When dream becomes reality, what will happen then?

Would you focus on chasing those dreams? Or focus on the man of your dreams?

[From [url=https://toreso.itch.io/blithe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于某人试图重新开始人生的故事。

他前往好友目前居住的小镇，能否弥补过去的过错？

当梦境化为现实，又会发生什么？

你会专注追逐梦想，还是会把心思放在梦中情人身上？

[来源：[url=https://toreso.itch.io/blithe]Itch.io[/url]]
